summary: Anachrony is a heavy sci-fi worker-placement game about rebuilding civilization after a cataclysm, with a signature time-travel mechanic where Exosuits sent to the past let players borrow future resources at a cost. It's dense with interlocking contracts, tech tracks, and production systems aimed at serious euro gamers.
praised: innovative and thematic time-travel loop mechanic
criticised: steep learning curve and heavy rules overhead
catch-up disaster track can feel frustrating to some

interaction.kind: worker placement with shared action spaces and contracts
interaction.detail: Players place workers on a common central board of action spaces and draft from shared contract offerings, so claiming an action or contract removes it from the others. Each player also manages a private base/tech board, so a significant share of the game state is individual even though the contested actions are shared.

scoring.how_you_win: Send workers through time to build an efficient production engine, construct buildings, advance your ministry track, and complete achievement tiles; the highest combined score when the round track or achievement supply runs out wins.
